scope: Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1; abstract F4 model F4Run in F4Containment.lean
statement: If a finite-dimensional D-closed subspace containing the generators has a degree-<=1 part of dimension below the number k of ideal elements with distinct linear leading variables (1 not in the ideal, degree-compatible order), no basis held by an F4 run with maximal step degree D is a Groebner basis: F4's maximal step degree exceeds D.
